review_notes: I read the whole file. The private declarations (originDerivative, originEpsilon, originAlpha, beta, tensorDetector and the other helpers) are scaffolding for a flatness-failure argument. Each one builds on existing Mathlib objects: MvPolynomial.pderiv, constantCoeff, QuotientAddGroup.lift, RingHom.toAlgebra, LinearMap.mul', TensorProduct.map and RingHom.Flat. I found no Mathlib declaration for "derivative at the origin as a map into R" that would replace originDerivative, and my grep for constantCoeff together with pderiv found only an unrelated MvPowerSeries lemma. The file does not introduce a competing version of an existing concept, so I report no finding. The remaining uncertainty is that I did not search Mathlib exhaustively for a point-derivation construction on polynomial rings.
